Founded in 1950, the Farmers Cooperative Association (FCA) is proud to be a member-owned cooperative with locations in Baxter Springs, Columbus & Galena, Kansas. We provide feed, fertilizer, seed, fuel, ag chemical, farm supplies, and grain storage to our members and the local farming and ranching community. We strive to be a competitive and forward-thinking cooperative. We maintain a dedicated staff that is committed to helping our patrons, their operations and the agricultural community. We have full time agronomists and feed nutritionists on staff to help your operation. We know that if you succeed, we succeed.
FCA MISSION STATEMENT: Our primary mission as the Farmers Cooperative Association (FCA) is to provide unwavering support to the local agricultural community by consistently offering quality products, progressive services, competitive prices, and a dedicated professional employee team.
